description: This file defines a benchmarking class 'ClassSerializeBenchmark' that compares the performance of various serialization methods (including Orleans, Utf8Json, System.Text.Json, MessagePack, Protobuf, Hyperion, ZeroFormatter, Newtonsoft.Json, and SpanJson) on class objects. It sets up different serializers, runs benchmarks, and measures serialization sizes.

classes.name: ClassSerializeBenchmark
classes.description: A benchmarking class that compares serialization performance of various serializers for class objects.

methods.name: Orleans
methods.description: Performs Orleans serialization of the Input object into a byte array.

methods.name: Utf8Json
methods.description: Serializes the Input object using Utf8Json and returns the length of the serialized data.

methods.name: SystemTextJson
methods.description: Serializes the Input object using System.Text.Json and returns the length of the serialized data.

methods.name: MessagePackCSharp
methods.description: Serializes the Input object using MessagePack and returns the size of the resulting byte array.

methods.name: ProtobufNet
methods.description: Serializes the Input object using Protobuf-net and returns the length of the serialized data.

methods.name: GoogleProtobuf
methods.description: Serializes the Input object using Google Protobuf and returns the length of the serialized data.

methods.name: Hyperion
methods.description: Serializes the Input object using Hyperion serializer and returns the length of the serialized data.

methods.name: ZeroFormatter
methods.description: Serializes the ZeroFormatterInput object using ZeroFormatter (commented out, not active).

methods.name: NewtonsoftJson
methods.description: Serializes the Input object using Newtonsoft.Json and returns the byte length.

methods.name: SpanJsonUtf8
methods.description: Serializes the Input object using SpanJson and returns the byte length.
